video_title: There’s More to Tatum vs. Brown Than Social Media Comments | Chris Mannix & Evan Turner

quotes.speaker: Evan Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA salary cap constraints make it difficult to build championship rosters
quotes.excerpt: The NBA is too loaded to try to ask Jayson and Jaylen to carry that

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Mannix
text_blocks.text: They went from a team that I think would have entered the season as a true championship contender to being one that to me is basically a second-round type of team right now.

text_blocks.speaker: Evan Turner
text_blocks.text: I'm right there with you. NBA teams are expensive as hell. Two people are going to take up 70% of the salary cap. The NBA is too loaded to try to ask Jayson and Jaylen to carry that with developing individuals. There's no guarantee they'll make it to a certain level and win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Chris Mannix
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics' championship window is closing due to lack of shot creation
quotes.excerpt: They missed Jaylen Brown's shot creation and they're going to miss Jaylen Brown's shot creation in the playoffs
quotes.quote: They are a worse team now than they were six months ago. Shot creation isn't there. There's a big burden on Jayson Tatum to create shots in the second half, specifically in the fourth quarter. To my eyes, it's Tatum, it's Peyton Pritchard, those are the two guys that can shot create. Paul George, good player, can get hot, he's a jump shooter. Same thing with Derrick White who is still struggling with that shot. All the other guys they've got, Ugo, Shairman, Robinson is a rebounder, same thing with Keda. They missed Jaylen Brown's shot creation and they're going to miss Jaylen Brown's shot creation in the playoffs. They went from a team that I think would have entered the season as a true championship contender to being one that to me is basically a second-round type of team right now.
